absence_boundary.rule: Every source component glyph 0 remains a verbatim provenance inscription but is normalized only to EmptyOne; it is never generated or consumed as a number.

controls.expected_rejection: An omitted assignment or equivalence component rejects.
Target-readable generation, numerical zero, free degeneracy or imported lookup rejects.
An axis-invariant class with a pair or a positive recurrence without a pair rejects.
A combined count other than the exact positive product rejects.
Treating source glyph 0 as a Fold number rejects.

evaluation_protocol.acceptance_condition: All 362 assignments pass; the vector contains exactly 170 inversion labels, 167 reflection labels, 32 positive and 330 absent axis-component coordinates, 11 source absence glyphs, 22 species and 360 state rows; all adverse controls pass.
evaluation_protocol.falsification_condition: The claim fails if equivalence merges different carriers or retained symmetry signatures; if axis-invariant support has more than one orientation; if a positive axis recurrence lacks the complementary pair; if the component census differs from positive spin multiplicity times positive orientation count; if any source absence glyph is treated as a number rather than EmptyOne; if any of 362 NIST term assignments, 170 inversion labels, 167 reflection labels, 32 positive axis-component labels, 330 absent axis-component coordinates, 11 source component-absence glyphs or their exact state inscriptions is omitted or mismapped; or if a changed label, free degeneracy, incomplete class, omitted row or tampered source is accepted.

metrics.definition: Independently reparse and retain all 362 NIST term assignments across all 360 registered state rows.
Retain every spin multiplicity, axis rank, orientation count, inversion, reflection, component and component-kind coordinate.
For every assignment enumerate exactly spin width times retained axis orientations as positive state-component occurrences.

external_measurement_sources.measurement_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology

frozen_relation.candidate_grammar: Generate the literal product of carrier, identity, spin, axis, orientation, symmetry, class and extension forms. Decide all 256 forms solely by admitted exact equivalence, held-label, spin, exclusion, support and finite-order laws.
frozen_relation.exact_domain: Every positive finite molecular electronic-state support; every positive spin multiplicity; structural axis invariance and every positive axis recurrence; both held inversion/reflection fibres where applicable; and structural EmptyOne wherever a symmetry coordinate is absent. Closure is depth-independent because each added component, multiplicity successor or axis recurrence repeats the same exact signature and complete-component checks.

scope_boundary: The external surface is the complete NIST term/symmetry assignment vector. The claim does not replace a term assignment with an energy-coincidence assertion and does not omit split or repeated states.
stop_condition: Halt on any violation; otherwise stop after the complete vector and controls.
